Help him keep the station safe!|A spacer and [[Inaldra/Legends|Inaldra's]] [[Inaldra's Lieutenant|Lieutenant]]|<ref name="SWG:StILtGW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Speak to Inaldra's Lieutenant to Get Work|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] served as the '''security director''' of [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located above [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Most of the cargo that was in there had been previously offloaded. They seem content to stay there, but that may not last. We cannot afford to let them run amok down there. Who knows what trouble they may cause?|The security director, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RtI" />}}
Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the security director worked out of the close combat training room of the station.<ref name="SWG:RtI" />

[[File:Tansarii_Point_Station_Cargo_Bay_2.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Hutt thugs in Cargo Bay 2]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the security director was very concerned about [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] who had taken over one of the lower cargo holds of Tansarii Point Station. He therefore hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to deal with the problem. The spacer headed to the lower level of the station where he had to fight and kill ten Hutt minions in Cargo Bay 2. The spacer eventually returned to the security director who payed him with [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for the trouble.<ref name="SWG:RtI" /> Later, [[Station Master]] [[Inaldra/Legends|Inaldra]] resolved definitively the situation with the Hutts by ordering a spacer to eliminate the Hutt [[Crime lord/Legends|boss]].<ref name="SWG:KtHB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Kill the Hutt Boss|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Security Director was a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RtI" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Security Director was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:New Player Tutorial|New Player Tutorial]],"<ref name="SWG:RtI" /> introduced with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> Strangely, he was dressed with the outfit usually worn in the game by [[Royal Security Police Force|Naboo Police officers]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>
